reading.title: Choosing an instrument at the club
reading.text: Maya joins an adult music club and asks about guitar, violin and cello. She notices how the cello rests upright while the player sits. Omar compares a bass guitar, harp and ukulele, then asks for the small four-string instrument. A banjo and mandolin stand beside a viola. The group also discusses double bass, flute and clarinet. Their teacher explains why saxophone belongs to woodwind despite its metal body, while trumpet and trombone belong to brass. They use stated sound-producing features and typical positions rather than guessing from material alone.
